control_contract.faulty: Use measured-current TVC only when an actual main is unavailable AND the CURRENT available unrequested gimballed-main torque capacity exceeds the existing physical RCS pair torque. Otherwise call exact legacy control, including steady requested-main, weak-tail coast and terminal. powered_terminal_alignment:false preserves the original terminal alignment gate. No new gains, time thresholds, physical limits, state assignment or energy law.
control_contract.healthy: Legacy fixed_v1 command arithmetic and all legacy guidance flags remain unchanged. New metadata alone is not physical restoration.
control_contract.scope: Single-setting causal ablation: shutdown_tail_only:true versus preserved all-phase terminal-allocation-v4. It may remain a physical negative; do not claim rescue, robustness, restart qualification or AI work.

interpretation.gate: Only two accepted saved-separation repair results from this same source/environment/profile/settings open a separate fresh-ground whole stage.
interpretation.invalid_or_budget: Stop entire stage on source/profile/site/goal/environment changes, invalid record, numerical or serialization/save/restore errors, output/disk/wall breach; no retry/resume.
interpretation.new_design: Diagnose preserved artifacts, then register a new sourcebound design if needed. Trial caps do not close the restoration project.
interpretation.valid_negative: Preserve unchanged negative and finish other registered case; do not tune or rerun within this design.
interpretation.whole_success: Report Ship, Booster, deployment and whole physical success separately. No AI/allfeatures/qualification claims.

purpose: Causal shutdown-tail-only allocation repair: only an actually unavailable-main vehicle and uncommanded current gimballed capacity above physical RCS torque uses measured TVC. Steady requested mains, coast and terminal otherwise use exact legacy commands; added powered alignment remains false. Exactly one allocation-only continuation from each original whole-flight H0/O0 rigid Booster separation. Disable the added early powered terminal alignment explicitly while retaining availability-aware measured-current TVC. This separates allocation effects from the early-slew fuel loss observed in terminal-v3. No source state, gains, thresholds or physical acceptance conditions are tuned.
retention: Keep source plans/claims/logs, original H0/O0 successes/negatives and all new outputs; archive/hash/readback/representative restore before later separately authorized cleanup. No public push, merge, Docker or worktree cleanup.
scope_limits: AI/image/symptom diagnosis/inflight approval/tower catch/arbitrary faults/qualification/develop/video are not included.
A valid original O0 negative is an admissible separation source; it is not required to have succeeded physically.
Contact is model geometry and controlled water-entry envelope only, not water response/postcontact support/real SpaceX qualification.
unchanged: Original physics/profile, mass/fuel, thrust/Isp, engine layout, RCS/flaps/gimbal authority, integration timesteps and reserve/contact/water limits.
Legacy fixed_v1 default, original v5/v7 admission and original state-mission-v1 records/registrations stay strict and unchanged.

New terminal-tail-v5 sets shutdown_tail_only:true and powered_terminal_alignment:false. Initial 33-to-3 and boostback-to-OFF shutdown loads can select measured allocation; steady requested mains, weak-tail coast and terminal resume exact legacy commands. No attitude/energy law, fitted threshold, ideal torque or favorable checkpoint.
Each stage has its own immutable plan and exclusive one-use parent/private-worker claims. No retry or resumed consumed cohort.
Default all-phase allocation and consumed terminal-v3/terminal-allocation-v4 registrations/results remain immutable. New setting shutdown_tail_only:true selects this separate design only.
